# Genprex bets on a one-time gene therapy for diabetes (Part 3 of 3)


** November 2, 2026


[Media Coverage](https://www.genprex.com/category/media-coverage/)[Diabetes](https://www.genprex.com/tag/diabetes/)[gene therapy](https://www.genprex.com/tag/gene-therapy/)


**Welcome to a special three-part series called ‘The Metabolic Moment’.**


In just a few years, GLP-1 drugs have become a phenomenon. They’ve transformed how we treat diabetes and obesity, created one of the biggest markets in pharma, and sparked a cultural conversation that reaches far beyond the clinic. Now that market is shifting. Cheaper alternatives are coming, new mechanisms are entering trials, and some companies are aiming for something closer to a cure.


So what happens next for patients, for the companies leading the field, and for the startups hoping to overtake them? Across three conversations, we’ll follow the money, the science, and the people behind this metabolic moment.


In part three of our series and ahead of Diabetes Awareness Month, I spoke with Ryan Confer, President and CEO of[Genprex](https://www.genprex.com/investors/downloads/) , about the company’s move from cancer into diabetes, the realities of making gene therapies at scale, and where a potential one-time treatment could fit alongside GLP-1s.
